title: Ben Johnson says Bears' QBs are in a better place in Year 2 in his offense

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ben Johnson says Bears' QBs are in a better place in Year 2 in his offense
sources.description: The Bears have kept stability at the most important position, with Caleb Williams remaining in place as the franchise quarterback and both of last year's backups, Tyson Bagent and Case Keenum, back as well.
